description: Finds the Debts Recovery Tribunal (DRT) bench or benches for an Indian city or state, with each bench’s address from the official DRT registry and the Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT) that hears its appeals. Use for questions such as which DRT a city falls under, where a DRT sits, or which DRAT hears appeals from a given DRT. With no city or state it lists every seat grouped by DRAT.

city.description: City or DRT seat, e.g. "Pune", "Noida", "DRT-2 Kolkata", "Bengaluru"

state.description: State or union territory, e.g. "Rajasthan" — used when no city is given, or to tell apart places with the same name

name: find_drt_bench
title: Find DRT bench and DRAT
